name: Wire Platform
description: Local-first personal AI dispatch platform. Orchestrates Claude, Gemini, Ollama, Codex, and system workers via WireProtocol v1 — typed, Ed25519-signed, AES-256-GCM encrypted. Offline-capable, HITL-gated shell execution, 2-layer semantic router.

schemes.description: Per-agent Ed25519 keypairs. Sender signs, recipient verifies. HMAC-SHA256 over canonical field-sorted JSON. X25519 ECDH for AES-256-GCM payload encryption.

skills.name: Linux / Shell Operations
skills.description: Execute Linux system operations from plain English. Covers all levels: disk, memory, processes, network, services, files, users, Docker, git. Every command requires explicit HITL approval before execution. Shell safety blocklist enforced at code level.
examples: show me my disk usage
what is eating my CPU
list open ports
install nginx and check if it's running

skills.name: Fast Local Tasks
skills.description: Quick local inference via qwen3:1.7b. Used for fast answers, simple lookups, and low-latency responses that do not require a larger model.
examples: what does this bash one-liner do
give me a quick regex for email validation

skills.name: Summarization
skills.description: Summarize text, files, standup notes, documents, or code sections. Runs locally via qwen3:1.7b.
examples: summarize my standup notes
tldr for the deployment log

skills.name: Explanations
skills.description: Explain code, architecture, concepts, or files using qwen3:4b (256K context). Can explain full source files.
examples: explain the dispatch loop architecture
what does this TypeScript generic do
how does X25519 key exchange work

skills.name: Research + Queries
skills.description: Research tasks, factual queries, and live web search. Routes to Gemini for real-time web queries (--live flag). Routes to local Ollama for static questions.
examples: research UK housing policy 2026
what is the weather in NYC
latest developments in AI agent frameworks

skills.name: Code Implementation
skills.description: Implement new features, modules, or systems. Routes to Claude (online) or Codex. Generates production-ready TypeScript/Bun code following project CLAUDE.md constraints.
examples: implement an auth guard for the API
build a SQLite migration runner in TypeScript

skills.name: Debugging
skills.description: Debug errors, trace exceptions, analyze crash logs, and identify root causes. Routes to Claude or local qwen2.5-coder:14b depending on complexity.
examples: fix the TypeError in router.ts line 42
why is the dispatch loop dropping messages

skills.name: Refactoring
skills.description: Refactor code for clarity, performance, or architecture. Routes to Claude or Codex.
examples: refactor the classifier to use a strategy pattern
clean up the envelope encode pipeline

skills.name: Code Review
skills.description: First-pass code review using qwen2.5-coder:14b locally. Covers style, patterns, risks, and missing tests. Optional escalation to Claude for security-critical review.
examples: review src/router/classifier.ts
code review the dispatch loop for race conditions

skills.name: Boilerplate Generation
skills.description: Generate project scaffolds, file templates, and boilerplate code. Routes to Codex.
examples: scaffold a new TypeScript Bun CLI command
generate a Zod schema for a user profile

skills.name: Verification
skills.description: Verify that code, architecture, or behavior meets stated requirements. Routes to Claude.
examples: verify the HMAC signing matches the WireProtocol spec
confirm the TTL expiry logic is correct

skills.name: Security Audit
skills.description: Security audit of code, configuration, or architecture. Routes to Claude (audit specialist). Also accessible via `wire diagnose` for structured multi-angle assessment.
examples: audit the key storage for permission issues
security review of the shell execution path

skills.name: WireProtocol Handoffs
skills.description: Wire-to-Wire protocol handoffs. Constructs typed, signed, encrypted messages for inter-agent communication using WireProtocol v1.
examples: send a task to the gemini agent
forward this research request to ollama

protocolFeatures: AES-256-GCM payload encryption (X25519 ECDH key exchange)
Nonce store in .wire-state/ for replay detection

router.layer1: Rule-based (19 routing rules, agent profiles, EMA weight learning)
router.layer2: qwen3:4b semantic classifier (256K context, structured output schema)

hitl.shellExecution: mandatory — every command shown before execution, y/N approval required
